item.title: Ukraine to start EU membership talks, ushering in years of reforms while fighting Russia’s war
item.description: Ukraine is officially opening negotiations for European Union membership

item.title: UK’s ban on Palestine Action was lawful, Court of Appeal says
item.description: The British government acted lawfully when it banned the protest group Palestine Action as a terrorist organization, the Court of Appeal in London has ruled

item.title: Sweden requires public workers to report migrants not authorized to live there
item.description: Sweden's parliament has passed a law requiring public sector workers to report unauthorized migrants to the police

item.title: Iran war is a 'wake-up call' for Southeast Asia's energy sector, report says
item.description: The International Energy Agency says Southeast Asia’s power sector is too open to risks from its dependence on imports of oil and gas from a limited number of suppliers
